name: 펠릭스
visual_review: 금발·초록 눈·창과 의상을 유지했습니다. 충전 자세 낮추기부터 몸통 비틀기·돌진 찌르기·창 회수의 차이가 읽힙니다.
motion_summary: Felix youthful tan-blond boy, green eyes, white shirt/dark straps and long spear exactly from portrait. R charges energy at spear tip then dashes into a powerful spear thrust. Animate spear resting diagonally; two hands grip and draw spear back; knees lower; tip starts pale gold lightning; twist hips to charge; maximum charge with green-white lightning; explosive forward lunge while spear extends horizontally right; full thrust with compact gold lightning dragon-like streak around point; recoil with bent leading knee; spear sweeps back; stand; exact original idle. Do not summon separate animal. Eye shape lively and determined with small mouth, unlike Nia.
